echoParts: and to all who are far off
verseText: ...you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off...
meaning: The Holy Spirit is God's gift to his people. His promise is for all who believe: young and old, near and far.

recall.question: What special gift does God promise to His people?

meaning.question: Who is God's promise of the Holy Spirit for?

application.prompt: God's gift of the Holy Spirit isn't just for grown-ups or people who lived long ago. It's for everyone who believes in Jesus! If you believe in Jesus, you have God's Spirit, no matter how old you are!
